title: Sheafification of presheaves of sets commutes with finite limits
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site whose underlying category has a set of objects and morphisms, $\mathrm{PSh}(\mathcal C)$ the category of presheaves of sets on $\mathcal C$, $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ the full subcategory of sheaves of sets, and $\#:\mathrm{PSh}(\mathcal C)\to\Sh(\mathcal C)$ the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], left adjoint to the inclusion. Then $\#$ commutes with finite limits; in particular it sends the final presheaf $*$ to the final sheaf $*$ and a product $\mathcal F_1\times\mathcal F_2$ (computed sectionwise) to $\mathcal F_1^\#\times\mathcal F_2^\#$ via the projections.
